title: Daily Devotional #58
paragraphs: As I read Luke 14 today, I am struck by the many lessons that You have for me in this chapter. I am grateful for the reminder that as Your follower, my love and service for You must be my top priority. In this chapter, You teach about humility, hospitality, and counting the cost of following You.

In verses 7-14, You encourage us to be humble and to not seek the places of honor at the table, but rather to take the lowest place and allow others to exalt us. This is a powerful reminder that true greatness is found in humility and in serving others. Help me to have a servant's heart and to always be willing to put others before myself.

In verses 15-24, You remind us of the importance of accepting Your invitation to follow You. You tell the parable of the great banquet and how those who were invited made excuses and did not come. But You persisted in inviting others to the feast, even those who were considered outcasts and unworthy. This is a powerful reminder that Your invitation is for all, and that we must not let anything stand in the way of accepting Your call to follow You.

In verses 25-33, You challenge us to count the cost of following You. You remind us that being Your disciple requires total commitment and sacrifice. We must be willing to give up everything to follow You. This is a hard teaching, but it is one that I need to hear. Help me to always remember that my love for You must be greater than anything else in my life.

Finally, in verses 34-35, You teach about the importance of being salt and light in the world. We are called to be a positive influence on those around us, and to bring flavor and light into a world that can be dark and tasteless. Help me to always be a reflection of Your love and grace, and to bring hope to those who are in need.
Thank You, Lord, for the lessons that You have taught me in Luke 14. Help me to apply these truths to my life, and to live out Your call to be Your disciple in all that I do. Amen.
